title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

type.description: SOLIDWORKS' type name for it, for example Extrusion, Cut, Fillet, RefPlane, ProfileFeature (a sketch).

kind.description: feature, sketch, plane, axis or point.

reference.description: Its persistent reference; absent when SOLIDWORKS gives none. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

parent.description: The feature it sits under (a sketch under the extrude that uses it); absent at the top level.

suppressed.description: True when it is suppressed in the active configuration.

error.description: Its rebuild error or warning code (swFeatureError_e name); absent when it rebuilt cleanly.

warning.description: True when Error is only a warning.
